name: Río Negro
shape: geoBoundaries, the province it is named for

climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A wine-producing province of Argentina, with Alto Valle de Río Negro, Avellaneda, General Conesa, General Roca and Pichimahuida inside.
